description.zh:
是否删除选定资源下所有的用户标签，默认为false。

- **true**：删除资源的标签。

- **false**：不删除资源的标签。

> 仅当**tagKeys**为空，**deleteAll=true**时，才可以删除所有的客户标签。
description.en:
Specifies whether to remove all existing tags from the specified resources. Default value: false. Valid values:

- **true**: removes all existing tags from the specified resources.

- **false**: does not remove all existing tags from the specified resources.

> All existing tags of a resource are removed only if the **tagKeys** parameter is left empty and the **DeleteAll** parameter is set to true.
The IDs of the resources from which you want to remove tags. You can specify up to 20 IDs.
The region in which the resource resides.

description.zh:
资源类型，取值：
- **application**：EDAS应用。 
- **cluster**：EDAS集群。
description.en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

- **application**: Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS) application

- **cluster**: EDAS cluster

description.zh: 要解绑的标签键列表，列表的取值范围1~20，json数组格式。
description.en: The tags that you want to remove. You can specify up to 20 tags. Set this parameter to a JSON array.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas untag-resources --resource-region-id cn-beijing --resource-type application --resource-ids f5ad6ff7-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-2axxxx82xxxx --tag-keys tagKey1_,_tagKey2 --delete-all true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun edas DELETE /pop/v5/tag/tags --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceRegionId 'cn-beijing' --ResourceIds 'f5ad6ff7-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-2axxxx82xxxx' --DeleteAll true --ResourceType application --TagKeys 'tagKey1_,_tagKey2' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
